e.title: glmMisrep · 纠正「风险状态瞒报」的 GLM 定价模型（R）
e.title_en: glmMisrep — GLMs that adjust for misrepresentation of a risk-status predictor (R)
e.title_hk: glmMisrep · 糾正「風險狀態瞞報」的 GLM 定價模型（R）
e.summary: 把「投保人故意瞒报风险状态」写进模型：估计瞒报比例，并按混合分布纠正 GLM 费率因子（CAS《Variance》方法）
e.summary_en: Models deliberate misreporting of a risk status: estimates its prevalence and corrects GLM rating factors via a mixture distribution (CAS Variance method)
e.summary_hk: 把「投保人故意瞞報風險狀態」寫進模型：估計瞞報比例，並按混合分布糾正 GLM 費率因子（CAS《Variance》方法）
e.body:
**glmMisrep** 要解决的，是精算建模里一个**大家都心知肚明、却极少写进模型**的问题：**投保人可能在核保时故意否认某项风险状态，以换取更低保费**。CRAN 页面把动机写得很直白——**"in insurance settings where policy holders may purposely deny a risk status in order to lower the insurance premium"**。可核实信息：**版本 0.1.3、2026-09-09 发布**、**GPL (≥ 2)**、作者 **Patrick Rafael（作者兼维护者，弗吉尼亚理工 pbr2608@vt.edu）、Michelle Xia、Rexford Akakpo**、**Depends R ≥ 3.5.0**、Imports `MASS`、**`poisson.glm.mix`**（CRAN 上确有此包，HTTP 200 实测）、无需编译、DOI `10.32614/CRAN.package.glmMisrep`。

方法（据 CRAN 描述）：对**连续型与计数型结果**拟合 GLM 的同时，**估计某个关键二元预测变量的「瞒报比例」**；做法是**把一部分响应视为来自混合分布**，用 **EM 算法**估计参数，标准误取自 **观测 Fisher 信息的闭式解**。方法出处：**Xia 等（2023）《Variance》——"Maximum likelihood approaches to misrepresentation models in GLM ratemaking: model comparisons"**（`variancejournal.org/article/73151`，HTTP 200 实测，813KB）——**《Variance》是 CAS（意外险精算学会）主办的研究期刊**，也就是说这不是通用统计套路，而是**直接出自产险费率厘定文献**。

对 RIAA：**瞒报（misrepresentation / 未如实告知）是保险的一等问题，不是数据清洗的小毛病**。标准 GLM 定价假定协变量被正确测量；一旦某个风险状态（吸烟、年里程、既往理赔、职业类别、车辆用途）**被系统性地低报**，拟合出的费率因子就会**沿着可预测的方向偏离**——低报风险的类别看上去「更安全」，于是拿到更便宜的费率、吸引更多同类人进来，**定价错误与逆选择相互加强**。这个包的价值在于把瞒报从「假设不存在」变成**一个被估计出来的参数（瞒报比例）**，从而可以**量化纠偏**，并在模型比较中检验「纠偏后费率是否更稳」。对做定价、核保或数据质量方向作业与论文的学生，这是一个**能直接落地的具体方法**，而不是又一篇泛泛讨论。相关条目：GLM 定价工具见 [[insurance-glm-tools]]、[[easy-glm]]、[[superglm]]、[[aglm]]，费率厘定全流程见 [[ratemaking]]，Tweedie 与索赔建模见 [[insurance-pricing-tweedie]]、[[insurance-frequency-severity]]、[[insurance-severity]]，离散度建模见 [[insurance-dispersion]]，可信度理论见 [[insurance-credibility]]，公平性议题见 [[insurance-fairness]]，费率因子解释见 [[shap-relativities]]，高基数协变量见 [[high-cardinality-covariates-regularization]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 版本 **0.1.3**，属早期实现，**CRAN 页面未列出代码仓库**（无可跟踪的 issue 与提交历史）；**②** 方法要求使用者**先假定瞒报的方向**（哪一类人往哪边瞒），**假定本身需要论证**；**③** 本轮只核实到 CRAN 页面与所引论文页面层面，**未运行代码、未在真实数据上验证纠偏效果**。**核实说明**：CRAN 页面与《Variance》论文页均 HTTP 200 实测，依赖包 `poisson.glm.mix` 在 CRAN 上确认存在；**未运行、未复现**。
e.body_en:
**glmMisrep** addresses something every actuarial modeller knows about but rarely writes into the model: **a policyholder may deliberately deny a risk status during underwriting in order to pay less**. The CRAN page states the motivation plainly — **"in insurance settings where policy holders may purposely deny a risk status in order to lower the insurance premium"**. Verifiable details: **version 0.1.3, published 2026-09-09**, **GPL (≥ 2)**, authors **Patrick Rafael (author and maintainer, Virginia Tech, pbr2608@vt.edu), Michelle Xia and Rexford Akakpo**, **Depends R ≥ 3.5.0**, Imports `MASS` and **`poisson.glm.mix`** (confirmed present on CRAN, HTTP 200), no compilation, DOI `10.32614/CRAN.package.glmMisrep`.

Method (per the CRAN description): fit GLMs to **continuous and count outcomes** while **estimating the prevalence of misrepresentation of an important binary predictor**; the approach treats **a subset of the response as arising from a mixture distribution**, estimates parameters by **EM**, and obtains standard errors from **closed-form observed Fisher information**. Provenance: **Xia et al. (2023), *Variance* — "Maximum likelihood approaches to misrepresentation models in GLM ratemaking: model comparisons"** (`variancejournal.org/article/73151`, measured HTTP 200, 813KB) — ***Variance* is the research journal of the CAS (Casualty Actuarial Society)**, so this is not a generic statistics recipe but work **straight out of the general-insurance ratemaking literature**.

For RIAA: **misrepresentation is a first-order insurance problem, not a data-cleaning nuisance**. Standard GLM pricing assumes covariates are measured correctly; once a risk status is **systematically under-reported** (smoking, annual mileage, prior claims, occupation class, vehicle use), the fitted relativities **shift in a predictable direction** — the under-reporting class *looks* safer, gets a cheaper rate, and attracts more of the same, so **pricing error and adverse selection reinforce each other**. What this package does is turn misrepresentation from an assumption of non-existence into **an estimated parameter (its prevalence)**, so the bias can be **quantified and corrected**, and "does the corrected rate hold up better?" becomes a testable model comparison. For students working on pricing, underwriting or data-quality assignments and dissertations, this is **a concrete method that can be applied**, rather than another general discussion. Related: GLM pricing tooling in [[insurance-glm-tools]], [[easy-glm]], [[superglm]] and [[aglm]]; the full ratemaking workflow in [[ratemaking]]; Tweedie and claim modelling in [[insurance-pricing-tweedie]], [[insurance-frequency-severity]] and [[insurance-severity]]; dispersion modelling in [[insurance-dispersion]]; credibility theory in [[insurance-credibility]]; fairness questions in [[insurance-fairness]]; rating-factor interpretation in [[shap-relativities]]; high-cardinality covariates in [[high-cardinality-covariates-regularization]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** version **0.1.3** is an early implementation and **the CRAN page lists no code repository** (no issue tracker or commit history to follow); **②** the method requires the user to **assume the direction of misreporting** (who misreports which way), and **that assumption itself needs justification**; **③** this check reached the CRAN page and the cited paper’s page only — **the code was not run and the correction was not validated on real data**. **Verification note**: the CRAN page and the *Variance* article page were both measured at HTTP 200, and the dependency `poisson.glm.mix` was confirmed to exist on CRAN; **nothing was run or reproduced**.
e.body_hk:
**glmMisrep** 要解決的是精算建模裡一個**大家都心知肚明、卻極少寫進模型**的問題：**投保人可能在核保時故意否認某項風險狀態，以換取更低保費**。CRAN 頁面把動機寫得很直白——**"in insurance settings where policy holders may purposely deny a risk status in order to lower the insurance premium"**。可核實資訊：**版本 0.1.3、2026-09-09 發布**、**GPL (≥ 2)**、作者 **Patrick Rafael（弗吉尼亞理工）、Michelle Xia、Rexford Akakpo**、**Depends R ≥ 3.5.0**、Imports `MASS` 與 **`poisson.glm.mix`**（CRAN 上確有此包）、無需編譯、DOI `10.32614/CRAN.package.glmMisrep`。

方法：對**連續型與計數型結果**擬合 GLM 的同時，**估計某個關鍵二元預測變量的「瞞報比例」**；把一部分響應視為來自**混合分布**，用 **EM** 估計參數，標準誤取自**觀測 Fisher 信息的閉式解**。出處：**Xia 等（2023）《Variance》**（`variancejournal.org/article/73151`，HTTP 200 實測）——**《Variance》是 CAS（意外險精算學會）的研究期刊**，即**直接出自產險費率釐定文獻**。

對 RIAA：**瞞報是保險的一等問題**。標準 GLM 定價假定協變量被正確測量；一旦某風險狀態（吸煙、年里程、既往理賠、職業類別）**被系統性低報**，費率因子就會**沿可預測方向偏離**——低報風險的類別看上去「更安全」，拿到更便宜費率、吸引更多同類人進來，**定價錯誤與逆選擇相互加強**。這個包把瞞報變成**一個被估計的參數**，從而可以**量化糾偏**。相關：[[insurance-glm-tools]]、[[easy-glm]]、[[superglm]]、[[aglm]]、[[ratemaking]]、[[insurance-pricing-tweedie]]、[[insurance-frequency-severity]]、[[insurance-severity]]、[[insurance-dispersion]]、[[insurance-credibility]]、[[insurance-fairness]]、[[shap-relativities]]、[[high-cardinality-covariates-regularization]]。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 版本 **0.1.3** 屬早期實現，**CRAN 頁面未列出代碼倉庫**；**②** 方法要求先**假定瞞報方向**，假定本身需論證；**③** 本輪只核實到 CRAN 頁面與論文頁面，**未運行代碼、未在真實數據上驗證**。**核實說明**：兩處均 HTTP 200 實測，依賴包在 CRAN 確認存在；**未運行、未複現**。
